data.name: Faizanah
data.gender_notes: Faizanah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who provides rain or causes abundance. Derived from the root 'fazana' meaning to rain, or to give. The name Faizanah carries the meaning “Rain, Abundance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Faizanah usually hope their child will grow to embody rain, abundance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine blessings and God's mercy.
data.etymology: Faizanah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rain, Abundance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faizanah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
